summary: Regensburg is steadily cutting car access to its UNESCO Altstadt: a council-backed traffic-calming package (2025, running to 2035) removes hundreds of public spaces and converts others to resident parking, while the city shifts parking to the edge with a new Stadtwerk garage and mobility hub at Unterer Wöhrd (approved 28-21 in July 2025, construction since February 2026, completion planned April 2027). Voters rejected the Stadtbahn in a June 2024 referendum, so the car-light strategy relies on buses, P+R and the Umweltzone. Stadtwerk Regensburg runs the main inner-city garages (Petersweg, Dachauplatz, Theater, TechCampus) and raised tariffs in April 2022 and April 2024. Coverage of private operators (Arcaden, Contipark, APCOA, Q-Park) and on-street/resident permit fees could not be sourced from pages that opened.

items.text: In May 2021 the Regensburg city council approved ending the free parking time in the three Stadtwerk-operated garages (Petersweg, Dachauplatz, Theater) from 1 April 2022; in exchange the electric Altstadtbus 'Emil' became free of charge from 1 June 2021.
items.source_title: Kostenloser Altstadtbus ersetzt kostenloses Parken

items.text: From 1 April 2022 das Stadtwerk.Regensburg introduced new tariffs in the Petersweg, Dachauplatz and Theater garages: EUR 0.50 per started 30 minutes for the first 1.5 hours, EUR 1.00 per started 30 minutes from 1.5 to 6.5 hours, EUR 12 for 6.5 to 24 hours, and a night/Sunday/holiday maximum of EUR 6; the previously free parking time was dropped.
items.source_title: Parken in Regensburg wird teurer

items.text: From 1 April 2024 Stadtwerk garage tariffs rose again: EUR 0.60 per started 30 minutes for the first hour, EUR 0.80 for 1 to 1.5 hours, EUR 1.10 per half hour up to 6.5 hours, EUR 14 for 6.5 to 24 hours and a night/Sunday/holiday maximum of EUR 7. The increase applies to Petersweg, Dachauplatz and the Theater garage; the TechCampus garage kept its prices.
items.source_title: Neue Tarife in den Parkgaragen von das Stadtwerk.Regensburg

items.text: The Regierung der Oberpfalz's second revision of the Regensburg air quality plan (November 2017) names the introduction of an Umweltzone as its main measure. The planned zone covers the Altstadt inside the Alleengürtel south of the Danube up to the railway line (1.41 km2, 1.8% of the city area); vehicles without a green sticker are barred.
items.source_title: Luftreinhalteplan für das Gebiet der Stadt Regensburg, 2. Fortschreibung (Regierung der Oberpfalz, November 2017)

items.text: The 2017 air quality plan lists the Park & Ride sites available for vehicles barred from the planned Umweltzone: Unterer Wöhrd (570 spaces), Kuglerplatz/Einhausung West (335), Bahnhof Prüfening (26), Bahnhof Burgweinting (50), E.ON Parkhaus Prüfeninger Straße (270, weekends) and the Dultplatz (2,400 when no major event takes place).
items.source_title: Luftreinhalteplan für das Gebiet der Stadt Regensburg, 2. Fortschreibung (Regierung der Oberpfalz, November 2017)

items.text: On 30 July 2019 Deutsche Umwelthilfe filed a court action at the Bavarian Administrative Court over Regensburg's nitrogen dioxide pollution, citing modelled exceedances of the EU limit of 40 ug/m3 on streets such as Weissenburgstrasse and Frankenstrasse and demanding diesel driving bans up to Euro 5.
items.source_title: Deutsche Umwelthilfe reicht Klagen für „Saubere Luft“ in Passau und Regensburg beim Bayerischen Verwaltungsgerichtshof ein

items.text: Stadtwerk Regensburg's 2023 media kit says it operates four garages with almost 2,000 spaces: Petersweg (560 spaces, reopened April 2014), Dachauplatz (700), Theater underground garage (355, renovated and available since October 2015) and TechCampus (377). Three inner-city garages lie in the Regensburg Umweltzone and may only be entered with a green sticker; the garages run on 100% REWAG green electricity.
items.source_title: Stadtwerk Mediadaten Parkgaragen 2023

items.text: According to Stadtwerk's 2023 media kit, EV charge points are provided at Petersweg (5), Dachauplatz (2 outside plus 5 on level 1) and the Theater garage (4), and 50 charge points were due in the TechCampus garage from spring 2023. E-carsharing cars of das Stadtwerk.Earl are stationed at Petersweg and Dachauplatz.
items.source_title: Stadtwerk Mediadaten Parkgaragen 2023

items.text: The city commissioned Stadtwerk.Regensburg to build the TechCampus quarter garage (377 spaces on 11 half-levels, 50 EV charging spaces, rooftop photovoltaics) on Franz-Mayer-Strasse in the former Nibelungen barracks; groundbreaking was 16 July 2021, investment about EUR 6.4 million, completion planned for autumn 2022.
items.source_title: Neues Parkhaus im TechCampus

items.text: In June 2024 the city opened public consultation (18 June to 19 July 2024) on the zoning plan for a 'Mobilitätsdrehscheibe' at Unterer Wöhrd, which would enlarge the parking area from about 670 to a maximum of 1,400 spaces (first stage 1,000 to 1,100), citing parking spaces lost in the Altstadt; the hub also includes bike storage and EV charging.
items.source_title: Mobilitätsdrehscheibe Regensburg: Deshalb gibt's bald weniger Parkplätze in der Innenstadt

items.text: In a referendum on 9 June 2024 Regensburg voters rejected continued planning of the Stadtbahn: 53.6% voted against, on a turnout of 55.9%. The city had begun formal Stadtbahn planning in June 2018; costs were estimated at about EUR 880 million (2023 prices) with a benefit-cost ratio of 1.54.
items.source_title: Regensburger haben entschieden: Aus für die Stadtbahn

items.text: Background to the Stadtbahn vote (article of 14 March 2024): formal planning began in June 2018; two lines were planned; estimated total cost about EUR 880 million (2023 prices), expected funding above 60% of eligible costs, a negative referendum result would end the project.
items.source_title: Bürgerentscheid zur Europawahl: Wie geht es weiter mit der Regensburger Stadtbahn?

items.text: The Park & Ride lot at Unterer Wöhrd became chargeable in July 2024: EUR 1 up to 12 hours and EUR 2 for 12 to 24 hours (exit free within 15 minutes if no space is found); the lot now has EV charging stations, e-scooter parking and bicycle boxes. The ACE motoring club criticised the new charge.
items.source_title: P+R Unterer Wöhrd jetzt kostenpflichtig – ACE-Kreisvorstand kritisiert die Stadt

items.text: The Vereinigung Freunde der Altstadt, in a statement on the Unterer Wöhrd zoning plan (July 2024), says the Petersweg garage was reopened in 2014 with capacity up from 460 to 560, that the public Dallmeier garage (Bahnhofstrasse 16, 200 spaces) is now also available, and that Altstadt garage spaces have therefore risen by 300 since 2014. It lists Dachauplatz 700, Petersweg 560, Theater/Bismarckplatz 355, Arnulfsplatz 170 and Castra Regina (Hauptbahnhof) 400 (advocacy group source).
items.source_title: Stellungnahme zum Bebauungsplan Nr. 279: Mobilitätsdrehscheibe Unterer Wöhrd (Freunde der Altstadt Regensburg)

items.text: In September 2024 the Unterer Wöhrd Mobilitätsdrehscheibe was reported at a total budget of EUR 18 million (parking garage about EUR 11.5 million), with about 1,000 spaces in total of which about 580 in the garage, plus e-charging, bike-/car-sharing and a micro depot; interim parking there cost EUR 1 for 12 hours and EUR 2 for 24 hours.
items.source_title: Mobilitätsdrehscheibe Unterer Wöhrd: Parkhaus-Monster oder Zukunfts-Oase?

items.text: From September 2024 to May 2025 the city redesigned the northern station forecourt (Bahnhofsvorplatz Nord): through traffic stays closed to private vehicles, a new turning area was created at the west end of Bahnhofstrasse, and generous bicycle parking and barrier-free surfaces were planned.
items.source_title: Bahnhofsvorplatz Nord: Umgestaltung gestartet

items.text: A Regensburg mobility survey (February 2023 to January 2024) found that, compared with 2018, the walking and cycling share of the modal split rose by five percentage points, car use fell by four points and public transport by one point.
items.source_title: Mobilitätserhebung Regensburg - Autos und Busse auf dem Rückzug

items.text: From 22 May 2025 all public paid parking spaces in the Obermünsterviertel were removed and replaced by 22 resident parking spaces plus 2 disabled spaces on Obermünsterplatz; the city pointed to the Petersweg garage and the Unterer Wöhrd lot (EUR 1 per 12 hours) as alternatives.
items.source_title: Wird das Obermünsterviertel in Regensburg zur grünen Stadtoase?

items.text: On 15 July 2025 the city planning committee voted on the Altstadt traffic-calming package: SPD, Greens, Freie Wähler, ÖDP and BSW voted yes, CSU and FDP no (CSU warned shops would suffer; FDP called the planned 1,000-space garage too small). The plan, as described in the press, removes 448 public parking spaces in the Altstadt, many being converted to resident parking.
items.source_title: Autos raus aus der Altstadt: Das halten die Parteien von den Plänen der Stadt

items.text: On 30 July 2025 Regensburg's city council approved the Mobilitätsdrehscheibe with parking garage at Unterer Wöhrd by 28 votes to 21, with completion planned for 2027.
items.source_title: Neues Parkhaus am Unteren Wöhrd kommt – ist es groß genug für die Zukunft?

items.text: In the week of 20 October 2025 the city began the first implementation phase of the Altstadt traffic-calming plan, which it says runs to 2035: public parking removed along about 60 m of Thundorferstrasse, new bike lanes on Thundorferstrasse, St.-Peters-Weg and Wöhrdstrasse, and public and resident parking on Wöhrdstrasse moved from the north side to the south-east.
items.source_title: Regensburg startet in die nächste Phase der Altstadtverkehrsberuhigung

items.text: Construction of the new Unterer Wöhrd garage started on 2 February 2026; during works 138 parking spaces and all motorhome pitches are lost and about 224 car spaces remain available. Developer is das Stadtwerk.Regensburg; P+R Jahnstadion and TechCampus are named as alternatives.
items.source_title: Baustart für neues Parkhaus Unterer Wöhrd in Regensburg

items.text: At the March 2026 groundbreaking the Unterer Wöhrd garage was described as having 580 spaces over ten levels (about 1,000 spaces including the open area, with 80 resident spaces), 50 EV charge points with more in preparation and rooftop photovoltaics; operator Stadtwerk Regensburg, builder Goldbeck, completion targeted for April 2027, tariffs not yet set.
items.source_title: Die Mobilitätsdrehscheibe: 2027 soll das Parkhaus am Unteren Wöhrd stehen

items.text: From 20 April 2026 the 2001 lift in the Theater underground garage at Bismarckplatz was renewed by das Stadtwerk.Regensburg for about EUR 90,000; for about eight weeks the garage was not step-free (three accessible spaces offered on Arnulfsplatz) and the new lift is 10 cm wider.
items.source_title: Theater-Tiefgarage am Bismarckplatz ist wochenlang nicht barrierefrei

items.text: On 16 July 2026 the city extended morning delivery hours in the Altstadt pedestrian zones by 30 minutes to 06:00 to 11:00 (evening window 17:30 to 19:30 unchanged), responding to requests from retailers, craftspeople, restaurants and hotels.
items.source_title: Ab sofort: Stadt genehmigt längere morgendliche Lieferzeiten in den Fußgängerzonen
